newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds quiet ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds quiet ahead of holiday.

text.p: Trading on the UK meals and feeds market was quiet ahead of the Easter holiday.
The market will be closed on Good Friday and Easter Monday and reopens on April 1.
Most sectors of the market were lower on Thursday with the sharply higher opening in Chicago driving any buyers that were around out of the market.
In light trading prior to the Chicago opening imported sunflower meal traded at 95 stg for spot ex-store Teignmouth while corn gluten feed pellets fetched 108 stg for spot Tilbury.
